newsitem.title: FRANCE: French minister says Boeing concessions incomplete.
newsitem.headline: French minister says Boeing concessions incomplete.

text.p: French European Affairs Minister Pierre Moscovici said on Wednesday that Boeing Co's "last-minute" concessions to win European clearance for its merger with McDonnell Douglas Corp did not seem complete and the European Commission would be firm with the U.S. company.

"Boeing made concessions at the last minute. They do not seem complete to me," he told France Inter radio, referring to the easing of the U.S. plane manufacturer's position on its controversial supply pacts with airlines.
The European Commission is expected to consider the merger on Wednesday.
"I think the Commission will be firm," Moscovici said.

He said the French government supported the firm stance, and he added that Europe was not cowed by U.S. President Bill Clinton's intervention. "It's better to be firm first and then negotiate," he said.
He declined to comment on any differences among EU member countries on the issue.
